title: Covered Seat Relief on Network and Server Order Deposits
content:
Seat relief points come off the infrastructure deposit percentage, the percentage at which the deposit on the approval of a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote is taken, by the seats currently covered on the client's active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement: **3.0 points** for at least **25** seats, **1.0 point** for at least **10** and fewer than 25 seats, and none for fewer seats or no active ClearPath agreement.

| Seats currently covered on the active agreement | Points off |
|---|---|
| fewer than 10 | none |
| 10 to 24 | 1.0 |
| 25 or more | 3.0 |
| no active agreement | none |

The seat count is the one currently on the client's ClearPath agreement whose status is active. At 9 seats no relief applies, at 10 the 1.0 point does, at 24 still 1.0, and at 25 the 3.0 points.
